title: Fast and Stable Triangular Inversion for Delta-Rule Linear Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2605.21325v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Linear attention has emerged as a cornerstone for efficient long-context architectures, as evidenced by its integration into state-of-the-art open-source models including Qwen3.5/3.6, Kimi Linear/K3, and RWKV-7. Models that incorporate linear attention layers with the so-called Delta-Rule involve the inversion of triangular matrices as a core sub-routine. This operation often forms a performance bottleneck, and, due to its high-sensitivity to numerical errors, it can significantly deteriorate end-to-end model accuracy if it is not carefully implemented. This work provides a systematic analysis of both direct and iterative triangular inversion algorithms, targeting methods that are rich in matrix products, and, therefore, have the potential to efficiently utilize modern hardware. To that end, our analysis covers a broad spectrum of mathematical and practical aspects, with a heavy focus on numerical stability, computational complexity,

translated_title: 面向Delta规则线性Transformer的快速且稳定的三角矩阵求逆
translated_abstract: 线性注意力已成为高效长上下文架构的基石，这一点从其被集成到Qwen3.5/3.6、Kimi Linear/K3和RWKV-7等最先进的开源模型中即可得到印证。采用所谓Delta规则的线性注意力层的模型，其核心子程序之一是三角矩阵求逆。这一操作往往构成性能瓶颈，并且由于其对数值误差高度敏感，若实现不当，会显著损害端到端模型的精度。本工作对直接法与迭代法三角矩阵求逆算法进行了系统性分析，重点关注富含矩阵乘积的方法，这类方法有潜力高效利用现代硬件。为此，我们的分析涵盖了数学与实践两方面的广泛内容，并着重关注数值稳定性、计算复杂度等方面。
tldr: 本文系统分析了Delta规则线性Transformer中三角矩阵求逆的直接法与迭代法算法，重点考察数值稳定性与计算复杂度，以解决该核心操作的性能瓶颈和数值精度问题。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically analyzes direct and iterative triangular inversion algorithms for Delta-Rule linear transformers, with a strong focus on numerical stability and computational complexity, to address the performance bottleneck and numerical accuracy issues of this core sub-routine.
